Field Service Technician
Coastal Water Utility

The utility keeps fourteen pumping stations running around the clock.

Key duties
Maintenance:
- Inspect pumps, valves and control panels on a fixed schedule.
- Repair faults reported by the control room.
Reporting:
- Record every site visit in the maintenance log.

Requirements:
- Diploma in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related technical field.
- Three years of experience maintaining industrial pumping equipment.
- Ability to read electrical schematics.
- Certified welder or boilermaker certificate.
- Communication and teamwork skills.
- Familiarity with SCADA systems or PLC programming.
- Basic knowledge of local water regulations.

Preferred:
- Experience with remote monitoring tools.
- Arabic language skills are an advantage.

Based at the Northern depot. On-call duty one week in four.
Salary: 1,800 per month.
Reports to the Operations Manager.
Successful candidates will undergo a medical examination before starting.
Our staff benefit from a pension scheme.
